title: Chapter 442
paragraphs: Chapter 442
Episode 127. To the Black King Corps (3)
The next day, Rutan headed to the Holy Kingdom, and Jin and Murakan went to find the Mila Kingdom.
They went to visit the top-secret bar 'Curtain' of Grace Shields (Misha).
The employees recognized the two right away, but they told the same story as the last time they visited.
"The owner is not here right now."
"It was the same when I came a few months ago. When will she be back?"
"Since the two of you visited last time, the owner has not returned even once."
It was common for Misha to be away for a month or two. As a representative of Soldelet, she had a very busy life, and it was natural for her to have numerous hiding places besides the Curtain.
However, it was almost unprecedented for her not to visit the Curtain as the seasons changed.
"Did she leave any letters for me and this friend?"
"No. It's been so long since we've had a situation like this that we were actually worried about the owner."
"Please tell her to contact us here when she returns."
As Jin handed over a piece of paper with an address and a small pouch of gold coins, the employee bowed with a dignified manner.
The two went to other hideouts that Misha had told them about, taking several teleportation gates until evening. They couldn't find her anywhere.
"Ha, they say when you need something, it's not there!"
Murakan seemed quite satisfied that he didn't have to meet her.
"Aren't you too happy about this? It's a little worrisome, isn't it?"
"What's there to worry about? What's the big deal if a dragon leaves its place for a few months? It's not like it's been decades. She must be relaxing somewhere."
"I have a bad feeling about this."
As Jin spoke, Murakan snorted.

"A bad feeling? That's good. It wouldn't be so bad if she's been caught by some powerful beings and is suffering terribly. The problem is that there probably aren't any beings in the world capable of doing that to her."
It was safe to say that there was no one who could catch Misha, as Murakan said.
To begin with, during the thousand years that Murakan was asleep, Misha had never been caught while fighting against the Ghost Army.
"That's true, but..."
For Jin, there were countless things he wanted to discuss with Misha as soon as possible.
The tomb of Temar, the leader of Kinzello, the demon dragon, chaos, Valeria, etc. Misha may not be able to clarify everything, but she seemed likely to provide some clues.
Especially regarding Valeria and her ongoing 'record restoration', she was the only one who could give the most appropriate information.
"Don't worry, let's go find the Black King Corps."
The Heukwangsan Fortress (黑王山砦) was located in the representative unprotected area of the central continent, the 'Non-Aligned Kingdom of Bise.'

Bise Kingdom was a small nation that did not belong to any of the representative 3 powers, which have now become 4 powers (Zifel, Runecandel, Bement, Kinzelo). The royal family and the military were maintained, but in reality, no one considered the Bise Kingdom's ruler to be the royal family.
Instead, the Heukwangdan and its leader were recognized as the true rulers of the Bise Kingdom.
It was a natural perception. The Heukwangdan possessed enough power to topple the Bise Kingdom with just a portion of their troops.
It was a well-known fact that the Heukwangdan did not seize the kingdom just to maintain their identity as a 'mercenary group.'
"Wow, they are really something."
"What is?"
"Usually, when a military group settles in such a small country, they would seize the royal family and exploit and oppress civilians."

Heukwangdan was far from that. They actually provided considerable support to the royal family and civilians, so much so that it wouldn't be an exaggeration to say they were sustaining the Bise Kingdom.

As a result, the Bise Kingdom was recognized as a good place to live, with constant immigration applications and numerous ancient relics and artifacts remaining intact, making it a bustling place for academy professors, scholars, and students every year.
"It's quite the opposite of the money-driven image that comes to mind when you think of mercenaries."
"They seem like nice and cute guys contrary to their name. If they're uncooperative, we could just give them a little beating."
"Nice, huh? I wonder about that."
At that, Jin laughed and continued.
"Why? Is there a problem?"
"The reason Heukwangdan manages and takes responsibility for the Bise Kingdom is not because they are kind-hearted philanthropists. This place, the Bise Kingdom, is their hostage warehouse."
As Jin said, the Heukwangdan used the Bise Kingdom as a hostage warehouse, making it the perfect shield for them to maintain their 'neutrality.'

Any major power wanting to suppress and absorb the Heukwangdan by force would have to trample the Bise Kingdom first, creating a structure that would inevitably lead to the deaths of countless residents and the destruction of ancient relics.
When Jin explained this, Murakan's eyes widened.
"Wow... So they're managing their image and practicality simultaneously while doing such villainous acts? They're really nasty and smart bastards. I don't like the name 'Heukwang' for that reason."
Of course, the Heukwangdan had the power to maintain neutrality even without the Bise Kingdom, but the more means they had, the better.
"Well, no hostages have been killed since I was born. We're about to arrive, so it's better to transform."
Poof, meow!

Murakan transformed into a butterfly Runecandel and sat on Jin's shoulder. Jin had dyed his hair red with a gold wire product and changed his face, so the gatekeepers of the Bise Kingdom and the civilians did not recognize him.
However, Jin was sure that someone in the Heukwangdan would recognize him as he walked around the Bise Kingdom like this.
'The 3rd rank members of Mureuka wouldn't have forgotten this look.'

When it was revealed that the black cat Jin had with him when he left the Storm Castle was Murakan, the conversation about it didn't stop for a while within the Black King's group. Of course, they said, the 'young emperor' wouldn't have just an ordinary cat with him.
As it was a city with many foreigners coming and going, Jin and Murakan didn't receive much attention.
Jin wandered around the nearby areas, looking at the advertisement boards and newsletters hanging everywhere from the Golden Sail group.
He subtly radiated an aura that couldn't be felt by anyone below 6-star.
Before long, as expected, Jin felt one mercenary approaching him.
"...That cat. You, could it be?"
The mercenary seemed unsure, but soon he was convinced that Jin was Jin Runcandel, whom he had personally escorted long ago.
"Ah, Lieutenant Ratam."
Before the mercenary could say more, Jin spoke first. At that, the mercenary was taken aback, unable to do anything but stare at Jin. He hadn't expected Jin to remember his name.
"I never thought you would remember my name. I'm ashamed that I didn't recognize you right away."
Ratam quickly bowed and answered.
"I remember you being by the side of then 3rd Corps Commander Muraka. Nice to see you again."
As soon as they shook hands, Ratam realized the rumors about Jin were true. He was secretly amazed by the immense power conveyed through Jin's grip.
"You didn't just come here for no reason, did you? Do you have business with the leader?"
The fact that he mentioned the leader directly, not another higher-up, showed that he recognized Jin's status to some extent.
"That's right."
"Fortunately, the leader is in the fortress now, so I'll guide you there personally. However, there are other guests here first, so please understand."
Even though Jin was a member of the 12th generation Runcandel, he couldn't meet the leader by pushing aside other guests without any notice.
From Ratam's words, Jin inferred one piece of information.
'Someone of higher status than me is here.'
That was accurate.

At that moment, in the Black King's fortress, there was a guest with a higher status than Jin, from the Black King's leader's point of view. Therefore, Jin had to wait until their business was finished.
'Who could it be?'
There weren't many people who came to mind immediately. He hoped that this unexpectedly courteous meeting would be with someone who wasn't too uncomfortable to be with.
"Of course, I understand."
"Thank you, please follow me."
When they arrived at the Black King's fortress following Ratam, it was close to midnight.
It didn't feel as tremendous as the aura of Guigok Bird Castle, but the mountain range where the fortress was located seemed to exude a different energy.

No dignitary could find the Black King's fortress beautiful or comfortable. If one didn't have the strength to climb the mountain range, they had to be carried by someone else, which was an embarrassing sight.
Riding a dragon or flying ship was the only way to maintain one's dignity, but there were only a few people in the world who could fly over the Black King's fortress.
Eventually, as Jin faced the magnificent sight of the Black King's fortress, situated halfway up the mountain, he couldn't help but admire it inwardly.

The sunken areas scattered around the mountainside seemed as if they were dug out by giants, and above them stood a line of dark, huge castles that seemed to have robust defensive walls at first glance.
Whether they were considering dragon invasions or not, the densely packed magic cannons pointed towards the sky, and various magic devices and traps seemed to wriggle like snakes.
'Looking at this, the Sword Garden seems quite modest.'

As Jin entered the central fortress, the lined-up mercenaries saluted him. The fact that Jin had visited had already spread throughout the fortress before he even finished climbing the mountain range.
"Welcome, Sir Jin Runcandel! Nice to see you again."
Muraka greeted Jin. On the way to the reception room, Jin occasionally searched for Zephirin with his eyes.
At the moment he was curious, he heard Zephirin's distinctive lively voice from ahead. It was right in front of the Black King's leader's reception room.
"I apologize, Second Commander!"
"Apologizing will do? Really? I don't know how furious the Third Commander you're with must be, huh? What were you thinking, being so rude in front of the leader's guest?"
"I didn't know any better!"

"No, why did you come to attend to the guest without even being called by the leader? Are you trying to steal the spotlight? Even thinking about it again, it's absurd. And why did you say you wanted to meet the first generation Runcandel...?"
"I'll bow my head!"
"Ah, your head. Hey, someone quickly get this out of my sight!"
Just as when they first met at the Sword Emperor's banquet hall, Zephirin had made a mistake and was being scolded.
"Ah... I, I. Sigh! I apologize, Sir Jin. You had to see such an embarrassing scene again."
"It's fine."
"What should I do with her? Hey, Zephirin! Come here right now!"
As Zephirin hurriedly ran over, she smiled at Jin again.
Jin and Murakan couldn't take their eyes off the huge axe-sword on her back, which looked even bigger than her body.
